sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 528 Bnss No. - 10721 of 2025
Applicant :- Neeru Devi

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Akhilesh Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1.

Heard Sri Akhilesh Kr. Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Rajeev Kr. Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State.
2. The instant application has been filed to quash entire proceeding of case No. 92 of 2013, under Section 498A, 323, IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Sikandra Rau, District Hathras, arising out of case crime No. 593 of 2012.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that dispute between the parties is matrimonial in nature and both the parties have settled their dispute amicably and entered into a written compromise dated 12.12.2024.
It has been requested that the impugned proceedings may be quashed on the basis of compromise.
4. Learned AGA states that the impugned proceeding cannot be quashed until the aforesaid compromise is verified.
5. In view of the above, the applicant is directed to file the original deed of compromise before the court below within a period of 15 days from today.

8. However, the parties are at liberty to file a fresh application under Section 528 BNSS to quash the impugned proceeding on the basis of verified copy of compromise, if need arises.
